dt: Applications open Nov 2026; deadline January 2027 (exact day not posted). Last deadline Jan 11, 2026
e: Summer research at Caltech and the LIGO Hanford and Livingston observatories for continuing undergraduates (GPA 2.5 or higher, at least one full-year physics course). US applicants must be US citizens, permanent residents or US nationals; students at institutions in India apply through LIGO India.
